summary: Full e2e testing of TemuJasa marketplace (backend + frontend). 20/20 backend pytest tests passed (services, technicians, orders, reviews, status updates, rating recalculation, duplicate rejection). Full UI flow tested on mobile viewport: Home -> Services (AC, 4 items) -> Technicians (3 for AC svc, sort by rating works) -> Order Summary -> Payment (OVO selected, total Rp 85.000) -> MyOrders (active tab shows new order) -> Order Tracking (timeline rendered) -> Complete job -> Completed tab -> Rating page (5 stars + textarea works). All navigation, data-testid selectors, and integrations function correctly.

issues: Bottom-nav placeholders (Chat/Favorit/Akun) link to routes without pages - clicking them produces blank route. Acceptable per spec (placeholder), but consider disabling or showing 'Coming Soon' for UX clarity.

action_items: Optional: Add 'Coming Soon' state to /chat /favorites /account placeholder routes (currently render blank).
Optional: Consider 201 status code on POST /api/orders and POST /api/reviews instead of default 200 for REST correctness.
critical_code_review_comments: server.py uses @app.on_event('shutdown') which is deprecated in FastAPI; migrate to lifespan handlers.

Order number generation `f"INV-{str(order_count + 345678).zfill(6)}"` is race-prone (count_documents not atomic) - could produce duplicate order numbers under concurrency. Acceptable for mock app but document.
datetime stored as ISO string in DB and converted back on every read - consider storing native datetime via Motor's BSON support to simplify code paths.
No pagination on /api/orders, /api/services, /api/technicians (hardcoded to_list(100)). Fine for mock data.
test_credentials: N/A - no authentication in this app
seed_data_creation: Backend tests created 1 order (status: completed) + 1 review on technician tech-001 (Pak Dedi). UI test created additional order in flow which got completed via complete-job button. Technician tech-001 rating/reviews_count updated by /api/reviews.
context_for_next_testing_agent: All happy-path flows verified passing. Category IDs are CapitalCase strings (AC, Listrik, Plumbing, Cleaning, 'Pet Servis'). Payment method testids use the method.id string e.g. payment-method-OVO. Review creation on an already-reviewed order correctly returns 400 'Review already exists for this order' - this was observed during UI test when re-rating a backend-test-created order. Bottom-nav routes /chat /favorites /account are placeholders only.
